sloka: प्लवमानः च मे दृष्टः स तस्मिन् गोमय ह्रदे ।पिबन्न् अन्जलिना तैलम् हसन्न् इव मुहुर् मुहुः ॥२-६९-९॥
transliteration: plavamānaḥ ca me dṛṣṭaḥ sa tasmin gomaya hrade ।pibann anjalinā tailam hasann iva muhur muhuḥ ॥2-69-9॥

translations.english: I saw my father floating in that pool of cow dung, drinking oil with cupped palms and bursting into laughter again and again.
